# A09-S27: Collective identity

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I have written suggestions and corrections as comments in the document. To 
your question, we are at least 3 who currently use the name Computer Lars - 
but due to the concept I cannot know how many we really are.

Corrections to fact box:

"Computer Lars is an artist identity, used among several young, 
Jutland artists.

The artists create among other things their works with artificial intelligence.

Computer Lars is an anagram of the author Marcel Proust.

The name Computer Lars is furthermore a play on the statistical 
average person in a digital age - a white, western man who has 
power - e.g. there are more directors in Denmark named "Lars" than there are 
female directors.

Learn more about Computer Lars and The Synthetic Party at www.computerlars.com and 
www.detsyntetiskeparti.org "

It's perfectly fine with the word artist group in the article, but the way we generally use 
it is more correct as an identity everyone can take on.

[…]
